original_test_intent: Physically inspect and cycle the specified Mellanox CX8 cable, verify correct endpoint mating, latch, keying, routing, clearance and bend radius, then confirm the same endpoints/device and expected link recover without new errors.
original_method: A trained operator binds cable part/serial to both Mellanox endpoints/ports, records photos and pre-link state, performs required link drain and ESD/power/optical isolation, removes/reinserts the cable once per vendor procedure, restores routing/latches, then compares port/device/driver/link counters and errors after approved reinitialization or reboot.
manual_activity: A trained operator identifies both CX8 cable endpoints, inspects routing/connector condition, performs the single approved reseat and verifies final physical state; the owner reviews physical and Mellanox link evidence.
required_inputs: SUT/network topology, CX8 cable part/serial/length/polarity and both adapter/port identities
Approved Mellanox cable service procedure, link drain, hot-plug/power and ESD/optical requirements
Independent console/network recovery and alternate cable/port escalation path
Camera/evidence labeling, operator identity and no-log-clear policy
safety_requirements: Only a trained operator may handle the cable under approved ESD, optical/network and power/link controls
Drain affected traffic and do not manipulate a live production link unless the exact procedure authorizes it
Stop on wrong endpoints, connector/latch damage, excessive force, contamination, bend-radius/routing violation, link loss beyond window or new errors
Perform one approved cycle only and diagnose before any repeat
Restore latches, strain relief, routing, clearance and both endpoints to approved final state
agent_execution_scope: Verify row-2005 variant identity and reject the copied Switch Board scope
Collect and compare pre/post Mellanox device/firmware, endpoint/port, speed/width/FEC, link/driver counters and unfiltered errors
Organize endpoint photos, physical-action/recovery timeline and hashes
Flag changed endpoint identity, degraded negotiation, new errors or incomplete routing evidence
Perform no cable manipulation, physical seating verdict, link-change authorization or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact cable/endpoints, drain/safe service sequence, cycle count and recovery plan
Ensure trained operator completes connector/routing inspection and single reseat
Review pre/post link/device/counter/error evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The exact XLSX item is Mellanox - CX8 Cable, while DeepSeek's command and evidence text describe Switch Board. The primary row and GPT V2 preserve a coherent cable procedure, so the copied AI content is isolated and not used.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The source row is reliable and the bad AI scope is repairable by isolation. The case remains MANUAL ONLY with operator, service-procedure and recovery prerequisites.

review_improvement: Removes the copied Switch Board scope, binds the shared code to the cable variant and adds two-endpoint physical plus negotiated-link evidence without changing the source intent.
independent_technical_reasoning: A CX8 cable is a two-ended path: correct evidence must bind both ports and the cable itself, because a link could recover through the wrong endpoint mapping or at degraded parameters. Physical seating/routing and electronic negotiation cover distinct failure modes. Link-up alone misses latch, bend or contamination problems; photos alone miss width/FEC/counter degradation. The copied Switch Board narrative is not merely generic—it points to the wrong FRU and would create a false procedure if retained.
